question: __________ can be played indoors or outdoors.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Volleyball**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Versatility:** Volleyball is a versatile sport that can be played both indoors and outdoors. Indoor volleyball is typically played on a wooden or synthetic court, while outdoor volleyball is often played on grass or sand (beach volleyball).
 
• **Team Sport:** It is a team sport with six players on each side in indoor volleyball and two players on each side in beach volleyball
